items.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: Oh yeah. Bix was one of my heroes.

ctx.x: I believe he was. Was Bix Beiderbecke a big sort of, influence, a love for you?

Oh yeah. Bix was one of my heroes. We almost share the same birthday. He is March 10 and I am March 11, and that’s about where the similarity is, because he had all the talent. And of course hanging with Bill he told me a lot of stuff about Bix and how much they really loved working together and they were in admiration of each other where Bix had all this talent that was just flowing like a mineral spring, and Bill could write it all down, what he could grab, whether it was his jazz phrasing or his modern piano…
Yeah. He was a meteor for sure.
